sources.note: Main marketing homepage. Describes ONC-certified EHR on HITRUST infrastructure. Lists core product categories and integrations.
Products page listing 8 modules: EHR, PMS, Patient Portal, Vezo (telemedicine), Hybrid eFax, IVR, CCM, RPM. Brief descriptions for each.
Detailed billing/PMS features: claims scrubbing, ERA posting, CPT macros, eligibility verification, KPI dashboards, PCI-compliant payments.
Lists 20+ supported specialties, three target industries (FQHC, PALTC, Out-Patient). HITRUST, ONC MU3, HIPAA certifications. No team bios or customer counts.
MIPS support page describing automated data collection, real-time dashboards, bi-weekly check-ins.
Links to annual Real World Testing plans and results for 2022-2025.
EHI export landing page with link to download EHI Export b.10 Documentation v2 PDF.
Mandatory ONC disclosures page. DOWN — returns HTTP 500 'Error establishing a database connection.' Compliance issue.
FHIR API documentation portal. Page loads only JavaScript monitoring code (New Relic/Sentry); actual content likely requires authentication or renders client-side only.
CCN Health RPM platform integration page for ethizo. Details cellular-connected device support, manufacturer partnerships (Tenovi, Dexcom, Omron, etc.), and vital signs captured.
iOS provider app. 3.5 stars, 60 ratings, highly polarized. Version 15.9.6 actively maintained. Reviews mention documentation efficiency gains but also crashes and unreliable AI features.
iOS patient app. 1.3 stars, 32 ratings (29 one-star). Widespread complaints about crashes, login failures, and unavailable medical records.
SLI Compliance usability testing report (Oct 2024). 15 participants, SUS score 86.53. Described as user-friendly.
Dun & Bradstreet listing indicating 5-9 employees and under $500K revenue. Headquartered at 518 33rd Ave CT NW, Gig Harbor, WA 98335.
ETHIZO trademark registration (serial 87597949, registration 6069819) by DocToMe Inc.
